15.t: Working with data: mother’s age and Down syndrome
q: Very low and almost flat until 30, then it rises steeply, especially after 35.
Explain how Down syndrome is caused.
An extra copy of chromosome 21 (47 in total), from non-disjunction when an egg forms in meiosis.
Most babies with Down syndrome are born to mothers under 35. Explain how this fits the graph.
Far more babies are born to younger mothers; a low rate times a large number gives more cases than a high rate times a small number.
